content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) for a project-based research fellowship position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available position is for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a DST-sponsored research project in the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post under advertisement number IIT/SRIC/R/AUB/2026/101.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 09-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated email address by this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 along with 10% HRA as per project norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through national level exams like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxations and upper age limits are governed as per the official project guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply via Email by sending their latest CV and scanned copies of supporting documents as a single PDF to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates applying to this post across all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, and Female candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit, followed by an online interview scheduled for the third or fourth week of October 2026.
